description: Northport Village took a bold step towards a brighter, greener future with its recent LED street lighting transformation. Spearheaded by Trustee Dave Weber, in collaboration with the New York Power Authority (NYPA), this visionary project showcased Northport's commitment to sustainability and innovation.
paid_for_by: Paid for by Friends of Dave Weber
title: Shining a Light on Northport Village's Sustainable Transformation: Trustee Dave Weber's Visionary LED Street Lighting Project - Trustee Dave Weber Jr.
